name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: The path to the current page as a list of links.
use: Where the current page sits in a hierarchy, with a link back to each level above it. It goes at the top of the page, inside a nav with a label.

instead.when: The list is a sequence a reader goes through in order, not a path of parent pages
The links are sibling views of one page
The links are the numbered pages of one long list

classes.name: breadcrumb
classes.description: The list of steps, on an ol inside a nav with aria-label. Steps wrap onto a second line when the row runs out

classes.name: breadcrumb-item
classes.description: A step, on an li. The stylesheet draws a chevron before every step but the first and mirrors it in right-to-left text

classes.name: breadcrumb-link
classes.description: The link of a step. A long name ends in an ellipsis at 16rem

states.name: current
states.description: The last step, the page the reader is on: strong ink

example:
1. Projects
  2. Atlas
  3. Deployments
